topic.source_contract: registered unit and map, rights and ownership, proposed works, consent route, notices and objections, decision, deregistration or exchange, implementation and public-access evidence

scope_guards: A recreational map is not treated as the statutory commons register.
Registered common land is not treated as publicly owned land.
A planning permission is not treated as consent for works on common land.
An application to deregister is not treated as deregistration.
Proposed replacement land is not treated as registered exchange land.
A right to roam is not treated as unrestricted development access.
A decision is not treated as implemented register amendment.
No score or promotion is written without exact register, rights, consent, decision, implementation and access evidence.
